title: Majestic Tour of Gujarat
shortDescription: Stretching into the Arabian Sea, Gujarat is renowned for its beaches, temple towns, palaces and historic capitals. Wildlife sanctuaries, hill resorts and natural grandeur add to its beauty.
description: Stretching into the Arabian Sea, Gujarat is renowned for its beaches, temple towns, palaces and historic capitals. Wildlife sanctuaries, hill resorts and natural grandeur add to its beauty. The state’s major attractions include the only habitat of the Asiatic lions in India (Gir Forests), the Wild Ass Sanctuary and the Indo-Saracenic architecture of Ahmedabad.

The colourful tribal villages of Kutch are also popular tourist destinations. Gujarat’s vast coastline is home to unique marine species and its varied geographical locations are said to make it a melting pot of culture, people, places and history

itinerary.title: Ahmedabad – Lothal – Rajkot
itinerary.description: Morning Departure to Rajkot en route visit Lothal . Lothal literally "mound of the dead", is the most extensively excavated site of Harappan site in India and therefore allows the most insight into the story of the Indus Valley civilization, its exuberant flight, and its tragic decay. Visiting places at Rajkot: If time permits, visit - Swamy Narayan Temple: It has been built out of Hand carved stones and the temple is renowned worldover for its social work and humanitarian services. Ishwarya Temple, Panch Nath Mahdeo temple, Ramakrishna Ashram, Asharamji Bapu Ashram, Rotary Mid Town Dolls Museum.

itinerary.title: Rajkot – Jamnagar – Bet Dwarka – Dwarka
itinerary.description: After early breakfast, departure to Dwarka. Local Visits Shri.Nageshwar Temple. Gopi Talab, Bet Dwaraka, Rukmini Temple and Transfer to Hotel. Evening visit Dwarkadhish Temple.

itinerary.title: Dwarka – Porbandar – Somnath
itinerary.description: After breakfast departure to Porbandar .Visit Birth place of Mahatma Gandhi (Kirti Mandir), Sudama Temple. Later on drive to Somnath (135 Kms. / 3 Hrs.) - Transfer to Hotel for fresh up and then Temple darshan. Evening have a fun in Saurashta Beach.

itinerary.title: Somnath – Sasan Gir
itinerary.description: After breakfast, departure to Sasan Gir and visit Sasan Gir safari park. Later proceed for local sight seeing Fort, Girnar Hills at Junagadh (55 Kms. / 1 hr. ). Check into Hotel.

itinerary.title: Sasan Gir – Ahmedabad
itinerary.description: After breakfast, departure to Gondal .Visit Naulakha palace and the famous Temple of Swaminarayan and then departure to Ahmedabad (250 Kms. / 6 Hrs.).

itinerary.title: Ahmedabad Drop
itinerary.description: Ahmedabad local sight seeing including visit to Akshardham Temple at Gandhinagar (30 Kms.). Evening transfer to Airport/Railway station.
